other_conditions: Loanee farmers must have taken a seasonal agricultural operations (SAO) loan from a financial institution (bank, co‑operative society, etc.).
Non‑loanee farmers must apply voluntarily before the deadline for each crop season.
Eligible crops and areas are announced by the government each year.
benefits_summary: Provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage with subsidized premiums and fast claim settlement directly to the farmer’s bank account.
documents_required: Aadhaar card or any government‑issued identity proof
Proof of land ownership or tenancy
Bank account details for claim disbursement
